payload:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
$wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-complete-workflows-audit-a1'
$branch='audit/complete-workflows-current-main-20260929'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'fetch failed' }
if(Test-Path $wt){ git worktree remove --force $wt | Out-Null }
git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"
if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ git branch -D $branch | Out-Null }
git worktree add -b $branch $wt origin/main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'worktree add failed' }
Set-Location $wt
$base=(git rev-parse HEAD | Out-String).Trim()
git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/codex/complete-mod-workflows
$mergeExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$conf=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
$changed=@(git diff --name-only HEAD)
if($mergeExit -ne 0){
  $summary=[ordered]@{base_main=$base;merge_exit=$mergeExit;conflicts=$conf;changed_count=$changed.Count;changed=$changed}
  git merge --abort | Out-Null
  $summary|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
  exit 0
}
& dotnet test 'tests\MhwModManager.Tests\MhwModManager.Tests.csproj' -c Release
$core=$LASTEXITCODE
& dotnet test 'tests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests\MhwModManager.AutomationTests.csproj' -c Release
$auto=$LASTEXITCODE
[ordered]@{base_main=$base;merge_exit=0;conflicts=@();changed_count=$changed.Count;changed=$changed;core_test_exit=$core;automation_test_exit=$auto}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
git merge --abort | Out-Null
exit 0
